```
module protocol7.coding.helper:enforce_quota

use protocol7.coding:job
use protocol7.coding:config
use protocol7.coding:log

#
# enforce_quota
#
# Reads a per-job byte quota from the config [default 4096]
# and logs a warning when a job's usage exceeds it.
#
# @param job_id  the job to check
# @param usage   the current byte usage of the job
# @return FALSE if the job has exceeded its quota, TRUE otherwise
#
@export
enforce_quota,
    job_id:  job_id,
    usage:   scalar,
    config:  scalar,
    log:     scalar

{
    local $max    = scalar(0)
    local $limit  = scalar(0)
    local $result = TRUE

    # Read the per-job byte quota from config, default 4096
    if ($config) {
        $max = scalar($config)
    } else {
        $max = scalar(4096)
    }

    # Update the job's usage tracking
    $limit = scalar($job_id)
    $limit = scalar($limit) + scalar($usage)

    # Check if the job has exceeded its quota
    if ($limit > $max) {
        $result = FALSE
        protocol7::log::warn(
            sprintf(
                "Job %s has exceeded its byte quota: %d > %d",
                scalar($job_id),
                scalar($limit),
                scalar($max)
            )
        )
    }

    return $result
}
```

## Complexity

| Operation | Time | Space |
|-----------|------|-------|
| Read quota from config | $O(1)$ | $O(1)$ |
| Update job usage tracking | $O(1)$ | $O(1)$ |
| Check quota threshold | $O(1)$ | $O(1)$ |
| Log warning | $O(1)$ | $O(1)$ |

## Usage

```
use protocol7.coding:enforce_quota

# Check if a job has exceeded its byte quota
if ($enforce_quota::enforce_quota($job_id, $usage, $config, $log) == FALSE) {
    # Handle quota violation
}
```
